# Every IGNORE below names why. An untuned baseline scan reports the same handful of
# header findings on every run, people stop reading it, and the one real finding
# arrives in a list nobody opens — so tuning is what keeps the signal alive, not a
# Vitrine is a deliberately vulnerable-ish demo marketplace served over plain HTTP
# inside a compose network. HSTS on a non-TLS origin is not actionable.

column3: (HSTS) no TLS terminator in the demo topology

column1: # The dashboard and marketplace are server-rendered with no third-party assets and
# no user-supplied HTML. CSP is still worth adding; it is not worth failing a PR
# The probe is served unminified and deliberately readable — see docs/ANTI-BOT.md.
# "JS file disclosure" is the intended design, not a finding.

column3: (information disclosure in JS) probe.js is public by design

column1: # Timestamp disclosure fires on every epoch-ms value in the telemetry API, which is
# the wire format, not a leak.

column3: (timestamp disclosure) epoch ms is part of the documented API

column1: # These must never be downgraded — they are the findings this scan exists for.

column3: absence of anti-CSRF tokens on state-changing forms
